sloka: दीर्घकालोषितस्तस्मिन् गिरौ गिरिवनप्रिय: ।वैदेह्या: प्रियमाकांक्षन् स्वं च चित्तं विलोभयन् ॥ २.९४.१॥
transliteration: dīrghakāloṣitastasmin girau girivanapriya: ।vaidehyā: priyamākāṁkṣan svaṁ ca cittaṁ vilobhayan ॥ 2.94.1॥

translations.english: Rama, resembling the gods, who had been living there for long developed a liking for the mountains and forests. With a desire to please Sita and his own mind, he showed her the wonderful Chitrakuta mountain as Indra did to his wife Sachi.
translations.hindi: अयोध्याकाण्ड का नब्बेवाँ रागे समाप्त हुआ । एकनवतितमः सगः 'कृतबुद्धि निवासाय तत्रेव स मुनिस्तदा । भरतं कैकयीपुत्रमातिथ्येन न्यमन्त्रयत्‌
